t: This is the East London Blitz Memorial, a war memorial in the London Borough of Tower Hamlets. It was made by Wendy Taylor, an English sculptor who specialises in permanent, site-specific commissions. She has described herself as one of the first artists of her generation to take art out of the galleries and onto the streets. Her work typically consists of large sculptures that look carefully balanced, so notice how this one is poised as you look at it, and think about what it commemorates.
